All 24 tests pass (12 in `DescriptiveStatisticsTest`, 12 in `SynchronizedDescriptiveStatisticsTest`).

## Summary

The file had already been thoroughly refactored over the prior four iterations (helper extractions for `appendStatLine`, `invokeSetQuantile`, `configurePercentileQuantile`, `validateSetQuantileSupport`, plus `SET_QUANTILE_*` constants). I made two small remaining cleanups:

1. **`addValue` (lines 166–175)** — eliminated a duplicate `getN()` call. The original evaluated `getN()` twice when the window was finite. Now: an early return for the infinite-window case, then `n` is cached once and used for both comparisons. Behavior is identical (the `n < windowSize` / `n == windowSize` branches still cover the same cases), but the conditional is linear and the redundant call is gone.

2. **`PROBE_QUANTILE` constant (line 78)** — the literal `50.0d` in `validateSetQuantileSupport` was an unexplained magic number. Extracted it as a named private constant, making the probing intent self-documenting at the call site.

No public API, signatures, numerical behavior, or tolerances were changed. All changes are Java 6/7 compatible.
